easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Linvala by sacrificing it.
When Linvala dies, Yedora triggers, returning Linvala from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Linvala enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Linvala by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Linvala face-up.
Resolve the Linvala ability from step 1.
Repeat.
